args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion (Pellow Home Living):

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest (18 May) says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". The old label makes the receiving supervisor search twice, and the label change is on the handoff list. We have not confirmed whether the report still has the old label today.
- "PHL" is also the shorthand for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so it collides in internal systems and search results. The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows; the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- Moss's Coastal cheat sheet still lists the account as "Covey & Lark Retail (Covey / CLR / PHL)" and needs the new name.
- Related open item: ticket PD-4821 (door 6 shows as available during the Tuesday maintenance block).

Could you confirm which name and code the report and systems should use, and who owns the rename clean-up?

Thanks,
Bettina (draft prepared with Sofia's notes)
